summary: Replication receive summaries correlate six phases with actual writer waits and holds, and link shared group-commit finalization without charging it exclusively to any request

replay.detail: Instrumentation only; no claims or projections are replayed.

rules.detail: No admission, batching, projection, continuation or deadline behavior changes.

compatibility.detail: Receive log correlation IDs are canonical validated exchange UUIDs or generated request UUIDs. Summaries add named phase elapsed/writer wait/writer hold durations and shared-event links. admit_ms now excludes the separately measured admission prelude and repairs. Shared finalization events carry bounded participant request/phase pairs and a process-local batch ID; first/last summary IDs are index hints, not exhaustive links. No request body or invalid header value is logged.

manual.detail: Join summary shared_event_join against shared finalization participants. Phase wall times, writer costs and shared durations are non-additive.

recovery.detail: Rollback removes the additional accounting; stored state is unchanged.
